visual.general_description: Clinical course plot of hemoglobin, bilirubin and CEA with alectinib and lorlatinib dose bars, transfusion arrows and a blood smear inset.
visual.detailed_description: A multi-axis clinical course plot on a white background. Along the top, a blue horizontal bar rises in three steps printed 150, 300 and 600 with the word Alectinib above it, followed after a gap by a longer orange bar printed 50 with the word Lorlatinib. The upper plot has a dark red left axis labelled Hb[g/dL] with ticks 7 to 15, and a right axis labelled T-Bil[mg/dL], D-Bil[mg/dL] (yellow and green text) with ticks 5 to 30. Dark red connected markers show Hb; yellow connected markers show T-Bil and green connected markers show D-Bil. Red text RBC 2U with four red downward arrows lies over the Hb series. A microscopy inset in the lower middle shows pink to lilac round cells with three red arrowheads and two purple-stained cells. The lower plot has a blue left axis labelled CEA[ng/mL] with ticks 5000 to 35000 and blue connected markers. The shared horizontal axis is labelled days with ticks 0 to 200. No dates, names or identifiers are printed.

visual.general_description: Uncaptioned graphical abstract image: clinical course plot of Hb, T-Bil, D-Bil and CEA against days, with dose bars, transfusion arrows and a blood smear inset.
visual.detailed_description: A smaller, uncaptioned copy of a multi-axis clinical course plot on a white background, matching the layout of the other course figure. Along the top, a blue horizontal bar rises in three steps printed 150, 300 and 600 with the word Alectinib above it, followed after a gap by a longer orange bar printed 50 with the word Lorlatinib. The upper plot has a dark red left axis labelled Hb[g/dL] with ticks 7 to 15, and a right axis labelled T-Bil[mg/dL], D-Bil[mg/dL] (yellow and green text) with ticks 5 to 30. Dark red connected markers show Hb; yellow connected markers show T-Bil and green connected markers show D-Bil. Red text RBC 2U with four red downward arrows lies over the Hb series. A microscopy inset in the lower middle shows pink to lilac round cells with three red arrowheads and two purple-stained cells. The lower plot has a blue left axis labelled CEA[ng/mL] with ticks 5000 to 35000 and blue connected markers. The shared horizontal axis is labelled days with ticks 0 to 200. No dates, names or identifiers are printed.
